name: Anna Smith
bioAdditions: Pelletreau (S1): 'Anna, widow of Ebenezer Smith, married Zephaniah Platt, and died March 12, 1813.' (The same date is given for her daughter Temperance Platt; one of the two may be an error.) Her children by Ebenezer include Richard 4th, grandfather of Judge J. Lawrence Smith; so she is the link that makes the J. Lawrence Smith family, James Clinch Smith and Bessie Smith White John's cousins through Job Smith 1st.

conflicts.foundValue: 12 Mar 1813 for Anna and also for her daughter Temperance (Pelletreau)
conflicts.assessment: Identical dates for mother and daughter suggest a copying error in Pelletreau; verify with gravestones.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Google scan (archive.org full text; used where the other scan's OCR drops text), App. pp. 465-466
